name: The Scarlet Crusade
summary: In Tirisfal, Deathknell faces a Scarlet Crusade camp southeast of the settlement. Executor Arren sends the newly awakened Forsaken to ambush its zealots, one of their most fanatical and persistent enemies.

sections.title: A Fanatical Threat
sections.body: After the Night Web spiders are dealt with, Executor Arren turns Deathknell toward a threat drawing near. A detachment of the Scarlet Crusade has made a foothold just southeast of the settlement. Its zealots see no difference between mindless Scourge and free-willed Forsaken. Their presence on Deathknell's border threatens the newly risen dead.

sections.title: Preemptive Retaliation
sections.body: Executor Arren orders a strike before the camp can grow into an organized attack on Deathknell. You cut down Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates, then bring back their crimson armbands as proof. The holy fanatics see all dead flesh as an abomination, leaving the Forsaken to claim survival by force.

faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade is a religious movement bent on exterminating the undead. Grief and religious zeal after Lordaeron's fall drove its members mad. They see no difference between mindless Scourge and self-aware Forsaken, and seek to purge both.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade camping near Deathknell?
faq.answer: Deathknell is where new Forsaken are raised and gathered. The Scarlet Crusade has set up a small outpost to survey the area, catch newly risen undead unawares, and gather forces against the young settlement.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken strike first rather than talk?
aliases: can forsaken negotiate with scarlet crusade
faq.answer: Executor Arren says the Crusaders are blinded by zeal and see all undead as abominations to be wiped out. They will not reason or negotiate with the dead, so the Forsaken strike first to defend themselves.

faq.q: What rank are the Crusaders found in this camp?
faq.answer: The camp is staffed largely by recruits and trainees: Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates. Though low in the Crusade's ranks, their fervor makes them dangerous to newly risen Forsaken.

faq.q: What does completing this mission lead to?
faq.answer: Executor Arren's superiors in Brill report that a Crusade messenger has come from the Scarlet Monastery to the camp. Arren sends you to intercept The Red Messenger and uncover their battle plans.
Executor Arren commands Deathknell's military and oversees its defense. He directs freshly awakened Forsaken against threats nearby.

angles.text: As a newly arisen Forsaken, you learn early that the living see you as a monster to be exterminated, whatever your free will.
The Scarlet Crusade's relentless aggression helps explain why the Forsaken sought the Horde's mutual defense and protection.
As a Forsaken priest, you face how the Holy Light you once revered in Lordaeron has been twisted into fanatical hatred.
